title: Ascribe to the Lord Glory

questions.question: Ascribe to the Lord, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the Lord what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:1 (ESV): "Ascribe to the Lord, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength."

questions.question: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:2 (ESV): "Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name;"

questions.question: Worship the Lord in the splendor of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:2 (ESV): "worship the Lord in the splendor of holiness."

questions.question: The voice of the Lord is over the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:3 (ESV): "The voice of the Lord is over the waters;"

questions.question: The God of glory thunders, the Lord, over many what?
The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:4 (ESV): "The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty."

questions.question: The voice of the Lord breaks the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:5 (ESV): "The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord breaks the cedars of Lebanon."

questions.question: He makes Lebanon to skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:6 (ESV): "...and Sirion like a young wild ox."

questions.question: The voice of the Lord flashes forth flames of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:7 (ESV): "The voice of the Lord flashes forth flames of fire."

questions.question: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:8 (ESV): "The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh."

questions.question: The voice of the Lord makes the deer give birth and strips the forests what?
And in his temple all cry, "What?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:9 (ESV): "...and in his temple all cry, 'Glory!'"

questions.question: The Lord sits enthroned over the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:10 (ESV): "The Lord sits enthroned over the flood;"

questions.question: May the Lord give strength to his people! May the Lord bless his people with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:11 (ESV): "May the Lord bless his people with peace!"

questions.question: The Lord sits enthroned as king when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 29:10 (ESV): "...the Lord sits enthroned as king forever."

key_verse_text: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord sits enthroned as king forever. May the Lord give strength to his people! May the Lord bless his people with peace!
